title: Unattended answer-file template declaration, version 1
description: Declares the placeholders an answer-file template carries and which of them are secret. Rendering is driven by this declaration rather than by scanning the template, so a placeholder that is present in one and not the other is an error instead of a silently unsubstituted token or an unnoticed extra substitution.

templateFile.description: The template this declaration describes, relative to the declaration's own directory. Never an absolute path and never traversing upward.

imageSelection.description: The image this answer file installs, which must agree with the qualified media reference. Setup selects an image; a build whose answer file and media reference disagree installs something other than what was qualified.

placeholders.description: Every placeholder the template carries. Rendering fails if the template holds one that is not declared here, or if this declares one the template does not hold.

name.description: Substituted where the template holds {{NAME}}. Upper snake case, so a placeholder is visually distinct from surrounding markup.

secret.description: True for a value that must never reach a log, an argument list, evidence, or an exception message. A secret value is written through a byte buffer that is cleared afterwards rather than through a managed string.
